distribution_status: PRIVATE - donor-derived. NOT to be committed to this or any public repository.
rationale: The donor repository carries no licence, so its SOURCE stays out of this repo (D5) and travels only as a verified diff. These artifacts are numeric program OUTPUT -- estimates, intervals, seeds, timings -- not donor expression, and output is not automatically covered by the licence of the program that produced it. That is a reason to archive them privately rather than discard ~10 CPU-hours of evidence; it is NOT a judgement that the donor use is licensed, and it would not extend to any artifact carrying donor source text, templates or graphics. None of these do: every one is numeric rows and identifiers.

regenerability: All of it is deterministically regenerable from the committed seed manifest, the patches and the donor base commit -- that is what R1/R2 established. What the archive protects is CPU time (~10 hours), not reproducibility. Losing it costs a rerun, not a result.
verification: sha256sum -c against the files list after extracting. The archive was extracted to a clean directory in-container and every member re-hashed to its staged value before transfer; the copy on the recipient's disk has NOT been verified from here and should be checked there.

m9b_cells.name: leadbench-mx-m9b-cells.tar.gz
m9b_cells.contents: 16 M9-B cells (1,600 rows each = 25,600 rows), their 16 seed logs (400 records each), the subprocess log and the runner stdout
m9b_cells.per_cell_record: docs/m9b-cell-manifest.json carries each cell's own sha256, row count, seed-log hash and wall clock, so a single lost cell can be regenerated and checked for identity without unpacking the archive.
